login.title: Sign in to your server
login.starting: Asking your account for a code…
login.instruction: On your phone or computer, open {url} and enter this code:
login.waiting: This screen carries on by itself once you have entered it.
login.expired: The code ran out before it was entered. Ask for a new one and try again.
login.failed: Your account could not be reached. Check the box is online, then try again.

home.empty: This server has nothing in it yet.

error.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. It may be switched off, or the box may be off the network.
error.signedOut: The server no longer accepts this sign-in. Sign in again to carry on.
error.noServer: This account has no server the box can reach.
error.unknown: Something went wrong talking to the server.

person.empty: Nothing else with {name} is on this server.
person.partial: The server did not say how many there are, so this list may be short.

player.hint: Arrows to find a scene · Down for buttons · Back to pause
player.hintScrub: The film is still playing. OK to jump here · Back or Down to cancel
player.qualityHint: Pick a lower one if the picture stalls. The server converts the film when you do.
player.hintPaused: OK to carry on · Down for buttons · Back to stop
player.hintButtons: Left and right to choose · OK to use it · Up for the timeline

settings.title: Settings
settings.autologinOnHint: The box starts as {who} without asking.
settings.autologinOffHint: The box asks who is watching each time it starts.
settings.autoSkipHint: Skips on its own when this is on. The marker is the server's guess, and a wrong one jumps past the opening of an episode.
settings.playbackHint: Subtitle size, position and colour, and skipping intros.
settings.homeRowsHint: Order and hide. Playlists sit last by default.
settings.themeMusicHint: A series plays its own theme while you look at it. Twice, then silence.

tracks.searchUnavailable: This server has no subtitle service set up.
tracks.title: Audio and subtitles

profiles.title: Who is watching?
profiles.none: This account has no other users.
